日期以獎牌為準：獎牌上有完整日期的寫完整日期；獎牌只寫年份的，以該賽事固定月份標示（上海 12 月、廈門 1 月、LA 3 月、OC 5 月、Surf City 2 月、Long Beach 10 月）。
Dates follow the medals: full dates where the medal shows them; where a medal shows only the year, the race's fixed month is shown.
2020 年 Long Beach 為線上虛擬賽。2020 Long Beach was a virtual race.
獎牌照片僅做扶正、統一相框與輕微亮度對比調整，未更換背景、未改動獎牌本身。Photos only straightened, uniformly framed, and lightly adjusted for brightness and contrast; backgrounds and medals untouched.
